discussion.title: The first hardware kits are being tested
discussion.body:
We have three ESP32 gateway boards on the bench this week.

| Sensor | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Vibration | readings match the simulator within 2 percent |
| Temperature | one sensor reads high, under investigation |

> [!NOTE]
> Kits are not for sale yet. See #431 for the plan.

![Three boards on a bench](https://example.test/boards.png)
